title: Explicit SetAttributeSingle and session teardown
purpose: Combine a valid-session unconnected explicit request with a distinct CIP service and an active-session teardown command.
expected_behavior: After the harness substitutes the negotiated handle in messages 1 and 2, the server parses the SetAttributeSingle request, may return a normal CIP response or an object-specific error, and then processes UnregisterSession for the active session.
constraints_preserved: CPF contains a Null Address Item followed by one Unconnected Data Item
The unconnected data item length is 10 bytes and matches the encoded service, path, and two-byte data value
The SetAttributeSingle path uses a two-word class/instance/attribute path in the inferred CIP layout
UnregisterSession uses command 0x0066, zero payload length, and the active runtime session handle
All three messages have complete 24-byte encapsulation headers
issue_safety_notes: Uses a bounded ordinary SetAttributeSingle request and valid-session teardown to provide state diversity. It does not reproduce the GetAttributeList count-80 condition, malformed lengths, or optional sockaddr structures.
